agent_notes: The NIRF Management and Overall 2025 listings both contain the exact institution name in Ayodhya, Uttar Pradesh.
Normal TLS requests returned the managed proxy self-signed certificate-chain error; curl --insecure was used only for public GETs to the expected official domains.

The official admission page links the current 2026-27 campus catalogue at rmlauadm.samarth.edu.in. It lists 130 entries; the entry explicitly named Test Programme (Do Not Apply) was excluded as non-active.

The official Ph.D. page links a portal whose public page is labelled Application Form for Ph.D. Common Entrance Test (CET-2024), so a current doctoral programme catalogue could not be established. The record therefore requires manual review and the catalogue status is partial_official_website.
Eleven catalogue entries have no responsible exact or close career-tree mapping: Library and Information Science, Yoga, Geography, and Home Science entries are left unmapped with mapping gaps.
